---
description: "Use when editing or refreshing azldev-generated skills under .agents/skills or instruction wrappers under .github/instructions. Explains how to rebuild them from azldev documentation."
applyTo: ".agents/skills/**,.github/instructions/**"
---

# Regenerating azldev agent guidance

- Treat files containing the footer `Generated by azldev docs agent; do not
  hand-edit.` as generated output. Do not edit them directly.
- Make durable guidance or template changes in the azldev source, then install the
  version pinned by `.azldev-version` as described in `DEVELOPING.md`.
- From this repository's root, rebuild the checked-in full skills and instruction
  wrappers with:

  ```bash
  azldev docs agent install --full
  ```

- Review the resulting changes under `.agents/skills/`, `.github/instructions/`,
  `.mcp.json`, and `.vscode/mcp.json` before committing them.
- Leave repository-authored skills and instructions without the generated footer
  unchanged unless the task explicitly targets them.
